regime: Rebound after forced selling in metals, with oil easing on peace talks and tech futures recovering
takeaway: Gold climbed back above $3,900 and silver above $50 overnight after Friday's sharp drop to one-year lows, narrowing the gold/silver ratio to about 78. Brent fell about 3% to near $110 as Iran–Qatar peace talks continued, and Nasdaq futures were up about 0.8%. The VIX is still near 19.5 and Tuesday's midterms and Friday's jobs report are ahead, so Friday's stress pattern has eased but not cleared.
